messages:
Ivy: opened PR to tighten the quotas + pricing page and add migration notes for Dedicated -> per-token billing. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/171. Main items: explicit meter table, small migration checklist, and a Go SDK retry example. PTAL.
Carlos: quick ask: can we separate "metering" and "rate limits" sections? customers keep confusing them in tickets.
Ivy: yes split done in the draft: Metering (billing) vs Rate limits (enforcement).
Priya: I added a short migration checklist for Dedicated customers: 1) map monthly GPU-hour commits to estimated monthly tokens, 2) propose committed token tier, 3) validate burst windows. Pasted sample mapping numbers.
doc-lint-bot: noticed inconsistent placeholder style: use {{token_cost}} everywhere. Also flagged an image path that 404s.
Ivy: fixed placeholders and swapped the image to a staging screenshot.
Jo: pushed a compact Go retry snippet to the PR and a note about setting idempotency keys for batched requests. Snippet: ```go
// exponential backoff for 429s
for i := 0; i < 5; i++ {
  resp, err := client.Generate(ctx, req)
  if err == nil { return resp, nil }
  if !isRateLimitErr(err) { return nil, err }
  time.Sleep(time.Duration(math.Pow(2, float64(i))) * 250 * time.Millisecond)
}
```
SupportBot: drafted a short customer email template for migration and added it to the PR comments.
Ivy: thanks all. will merge once screenshots from staging are confirmed and CI passes. tagging for merge-on-green. :white_check_mark:
